mapper.select: select a.id as id, a.id as orderSkuId, a.order_id as orderId, a.quotation_sku_packing_id as quotationSkuPackingId, a.box_num as boxNum, a.packing_num as packingNum, a.packing_id as packingId, b.name as packingName, a.packing_size as packingSize, a.packing_cost as packingCost, a.remark as remark, a.sku_id as skuId, d.name as skuName, a.quotation_sku_id as quotationSkuId, a.product_id as productId, e.code as productCode, e.name as productName, a.quotation_id as quotationId, c.quotation_code as quotationCode, a.quotation_price as quotationPrice, a.quantity as quantity, a.volume as volume, a.match_id as matchId, f.id as combinationId, f.name as matchName from sal_sed_order_detail a left join pro_sed_packing b on a.packing_id = b.id left join sal_sed_quotation_sku_packing g on a.quotation_sku_packing_id = g.id left join pro_sed_product_match_sku d on a.sku_id = d.id left join pro_sed_product_match f on d.match_id = f.id left join pro_sed_product e on f.product_id = e.id left join sal_sed_quotation c on a.quotation_id = c.id where a.order_id = #{orderId} and a.is_deleted = 0
